summary: This change wraps public app view pages in a gateway banner page. The local waitlist route and table are removed, and the banner form now posts to the existing Buttondown list (the same one LandingPage uses) in a new tab. The in-frame routing fix from round 2 is kept. Durable tests cover the banner page, content routing and visibility rules, a temp Playwright test checks the new-tab Buttondown post and that the app keeps working, all tests pass, and every changed line is covered.
